title: FRED S&P 500 daily series and reuse notice
author: S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC / Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

chunks.heading: Coverage
chunks.body: FRED provides ten years of daily S&P 500 close history under its agreement with S&P Dow Jones Indices.

chunks.heading: Rights gate
chunks.body: The series notes prohibit reproduction without prior written permission. Keep only metadata and transformed audit findings; do not incorporate or version the raw series until use rights are resolved.
